qualifier: estrogen and androgen transcriptional responses
name: Estrogen, androgen and progesterone receptor signalling
rationale: All members concern ligand-activated sex steroid receptor signalling and target-gene responses, and combining estrogen with androgen (AR, KLK2/3, prostate) programmes separates it from the estrogen/progesterone-only, thyroid hormone, and gland-development neighbours.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and energy metabolism
qualifier: nuclear receptors and SREBP-driven cholesterol synthesis
name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP regulation of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor (LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB) and SREBP/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of cholesterol, lipid and glucose metabolism, distinguished from the adipogenesis- and ChREBP/sugar-centred neighbours by SREBP/cholesterol and nuclear receptor content.

qualifier: recombination and break-induced replication
name: Recombinational telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere protection and recombination-based maintenance (D-loop, t-circles) together with break-induced replication and recombination-intermediate resolution, which the telomere-packaging and general DNA-repair neighbours lack.

qualifier: BH3-only and BAX/BAK outer membrane permeabilization
name: BCL-2 family control of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
rationale: All members cover BH3-only protein activation, BAX/BAK oligomerization and regulation of MOMP and cytochrome c release, upstream of the apoptosome, caspase and SMAC steps that define the confusables.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPases
name: RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPase regulation
rationale: Members are small GTPase cycles and activity regulation (RHOBTB1-3, Rhotekin/Rhophilin effectors, Ral), distinguished from Golgi-Rho, Rab/ARF, protein-stability and neddylation neighbours by the RHOBTB and Ral content.

qualifier: positive and negative regulators, alternative and classical pathways
name: Regulation of alternative and classical complement activation
rationale: All members concern positive or negative regulation of complement activation, especially the alternative pathway, whereas the confusables are dominated by the activation cascades themselves (classical, lectin, C3/C5).

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and brainstem
name: Brainstem and cerebellar granule layer development
rationale: Members concern development of hindbrain structures (pons, brainstem, cerebellar granule layer, Bergmann glia) and their functions, distinguished from Purkinje-layer, forebrain and motor-behaviour neighbours by granule-layer and brainstem content.

qualifier: cardiac outflow tract, great arteries and trachea
name: Pharyngeal arch and cardiac neural crest derivative development
rationale: Members are organs and vessels derived from the pharyngeal apparatus (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, palate, trachea, outflow tract, arch arteries), and the cardiac neural crest/outflow tract and tracheal members separate it from craniofacial and limb neighbours.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage and coenzyme A from vitamin precursors
name: Vitamin-derived NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism
rationale: Members cover NAD(P) synthesis, salvage, transport and catabolism from nicotinate and coenzyme A synthesis from pantothenate, distinguished from tryptophan de novo NAD, creatine and pyruvate dehydrogenase neighbours.

core: Inborn errors of innate immune signalling
qualifier: MyD88, IRAK4 and IKK/IkBa deficiencies
name: Primary immunodeficiencies of TLR-MyD88-NF-kB signalling
rationale: All members are inherited deficiencies of MyD88, IRAK4, IKBKB, IKBKG or IkBa that disrupt TLR-to-NF-kB signalling, whereas the confusables describe normal TLR, inflammasome or non-canonical NF-kB signalling.

qualifier: shared T and NK cell modules
name: Shared T and NK cell transcriptional signature
rationale: All three members are co-expression modules marking T cells and NK cells together, whereas each confusable is T-cell-specific or NK-cell-specific signalling and differentiation.

qualifier: myocardial growth, trabeculation and second heart field
name: Myocardial growth, trabeculation and second heart field development
rationale: Members concern cardiac muscle and chamber formation (ventricular trabecular and compact myocardium, second heart field, heart tube), distinguished from valve/endocardial cushion, septum and conduction-system neighbours.

qualifier: lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy
name: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet biogenesis, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy with triglyceride storage homeostasis, distinguished from LXR-transcription, glycerolipid synthesis and fatty acid oxidation neighbours.

core: Endosomal and vesicle trafficking to membranes
qualifier: atypical RHOQ and RHOT GTPases, GLUT4 translocation
name: Endosomal trafficking and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
rationale: Members concern endosomal transport, pinocytosis, transcytosis and membrane targeting (including GLUT4 translocation) together with RHOQ and RHOT GTPase cycles, which the endocytosis and macropinocytosis neighbours lack.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and liver development/regeneration
name: Thyroid hormone receptor signalling and liver development
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone/nuclear receptor transcription with hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration, separating it from sex-steroid, retinoic acid, lipid-metabolic and SREBP nuclear-receptor neighbours.

qualifier: structural proteins and virion assembly
name: Viral structural protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members concern processing of viral structural proteins (spike, E, 3a, dengue proteins) and their assembly at the budding site, distinguished from neighbours covering viral entry, replicase translation and host modulation.

qualifier: protein-level interactions, trafficking and degradation
name: Classical cadherin protein interactions, trafficking and turnover
rationale: All members concern CDH1 and CDH11 at the protein level (homotypic interactions, processing, trafficking, degradation), whereas confusables cover cadherin gene transcription, EMT, junction assembly and desmosomes.

qualifier: co-expressed matrix module signatures
name: Co-expressed extracellular matrix and associated protein signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules dominated by extracellular matrix and matrix-associated genes, distinguished from neighbours describing specific collagen, elastic fibre, integrin or stromal processes.

qualifier: ganglioside catabolism and glycolipid transport
name: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism and glycolipid transport
rationale: Members concern lysosomal degradation of gangliosides and glycosphingolipids (including GM2 gangliosidoses and sialidosis) plus glycolipid transport, distinguished from glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and sialic acid/N-glycan neighbours.

qualifier: Pol I elongation and termination plus 5S transcription
name: rRNA transcription elongation and termination
rationale: Members concern later steps of rRNA transcription (Pol I elongation and termination, Pol III 5S rRNA) with ITS2 processing, distinguished from neighbours centred on Pol I initiation and chromatin regulation, Pol III termination or 5' rRNA processing.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKB downstream PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKB neurotrophin receptor signalling
rationale: Members are TRK receptor downstream events (NTRK2 via PI3K, CDK5, RAC1; TRKA via FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB), distinguished from NTRK2 RAS/PLCG1, NTRK3 and p75NTR neighbours.

qualifier: mating, parturition and uterine contraction
name: Reproductive and social behaviour, mating and parturition
rationale: Members concern mating, parental and aggressive behaviour plus reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, parturition, uterine contraction, relaxin), distinguished from general behaviour, urinary smooth muscle and tachykinin signalling neighbours.

qualifier: spliceosome assembly and splice site recognition
name: Spliceosome assembly and pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: All members describe spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and major/minor pre-mRNA splicing, whereas confusables concern snRNA transcription, Pol III transcription and nuclear RNA decay.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-driven apoptosis and ferroptosis
name: Oxidative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis
rationale: Members regulate cell death and responses triggered by hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides and nitrosative stress, including intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis, distinguished from ischemia/oxygen and mitochondrial respiration neighbours.

qualifier: bilirubin handling and hyperbilirubinemia disorders
name: Hepatic bilirubin and drug organic anion clearance
rationale: Members concern heme degradation and bilirubin/drug uptake, glucuronidation and excretion via SLCO, UGT1A and ABCC2 (with their hyperbilirubinemia defects), distinguished from sulfonation, xenobiotic and organic cation transport neighbours.
